test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill In blank number 2.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Consists** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Consists **means to be made up or composed of something. (किसी चीज से बना या बना हुआ होना) • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits the context of the sentence. • **For example**: *The team consists of five members.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Surrounds **means to encircle or enclose something. (किसी चीज़ को घेरना या घेरना) • **Measures **means to determine the size, amount, or degree of something. (किसी चीज़ का आकार, मात्रा या डिग्री निर्धारित करना) • **Considers **means to think about or regard something in a particular way. (किसी चीज़ के बारे में एक विशेष तरीके से सोचना या मानना) 1c2:T890, The correct answer is: '**on**'
